panels.title: Service checker results
panels.description: Counts in the selected time range. A configured service with zero actions stays visible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "Service",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.action = 'check') AS "CHECK",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.action = 'put') AS "PUT",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.action = 'get') AS "GET",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 101) AS "UP",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 102) AS "CORRUPT",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 103) AS "MUMBLE",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 104) AS "DOWN",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 110) AS "CHECK FAILED",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.timed_out) AS "Timeouts",
       max(e.time) AS "Last run"
FROM checker_services AS s
LEFT JOIN checker_action_events AS e
  ON e.service_id = s.id
 AND $__timeFilter(e.time)
 AND e.team_id::TEXT IN (${team:sqlstring})
WHERE s.id::TEXT IN (${service:sqlstring})
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY s.name

panels.title: Recent checker actions
panels.description: Persisted CHECK, PUT and GET actions for each service and team. Checker messages are withheld.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.time AS "Time", e.round AS "Round", e.service AS "Service",
       e.team AS "Team", upper(e.action) AS "Action", e.status AS "Code",
       CASE e.status
         WHEN 101 THEN 'UP' WHEN 102 THEN 'CORRUPT'
         WHEN 103 THEN 'MUMBLE' WHEN 104 THEN 'DOWN'
         WHEN 110 THEN 'CHECK FAILED' END AS "Result",
       e.duration_ms AS "Duration ms", e.timed_out AS "Timeout"
FROM checker_action_events AS e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time)
  AND e.service_id::TEXT IN (${service:sqlstring})
  AND e.team_id::TEXT IN (${team:sqlstring})
ORDER BY e.time DESC, e.id DESC
LIMIT 200
